dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "Grandpa, everyone else has decided to leave. You're the only one left. Please, Grandpa, trust me... just this once. I promise you I've found the way out."

dialogues.speaker: Echoing Conch
dialogues.text: "...*sigh* Very well. I will give you my trust. All of our fates now lie in your hands."
